footer: You can switch off notifications in your profile: {url}

requestNew.subject: New request for spot {spot}
requestNew.body: {tenant} would like to rent your spot {spot} from {start} to {end} for {price}.

requestConfirmed.subject: Confirmed: spot {spot}
requestConfirmed.body: The booking for spot {spot} from {start} to {end} ({price}) is confirmed. The rental contract is attached as PDF.

requestDeclined.subject: Request declined: spot {spot}
requestDeclined.body: Unfortunately your request for spot {spot} from {start} to {end} was declined.

requestExpired.subject: Request expired: spot {spot}
requestExpired.body: Your request for spot {spot} from {start} to {end} was not answered in time and has expired.

bookingCancelled.subject: Cancelled: spot {spot}
bookingCancelled.body: The booking for spot {spot} from {start} to {end} has been cancelled.

paymentProblem.subject: Payment problem: spot {spot}
paymentProblem.body: There was a problem with the payment for spot {spot} ({start} – {end}, {price}).

startsSoon.subject: Starting soon: spot {spot}
startsSoon.body: Your booking for spot {spot} starts at {start}.

endsSoon.subject: Ending soon: spot {spot}
endsSoon.body: Your booking for spot {spot} ends at {end}. Please vacate the spot on time or extend in the app.

problemReported.subject: Problem report for spot {spot}
problemReported.body: {reporter} reported a problem for the booking of spot {spot} ({start}):

payoutHint: You receive approx. {payout} after the payment provider fee.
ownerConfirmedHint: Tenant: {tenant}. The tenant is now being charged.
freeSpotsHint: Find other available spots for the same period here: {url}
refundHint: The full amount of {price} will be refunded automatically.
cancelledByTenant: The tenant cancelled. The spot is available again.
cancelledBySystem: The booking was cancelled automatically because the payment was not completed in time. The spot is available again.
paymentRetryHint: Please pay in the app by {deadline}, otherwise the booking will be cancelled automatically.
paymentBouncedOwner: The tenant's direct debit bounced. The tenant has been informed and can pay within 12 hours.

deletionRequested.subject: Account deletion request
deletionRequested.body: {name} has requested deletion of their account.
